raw.details:
Overview

Date: 13 October 2026
Venue: IT Lab

The coding event will consist of two compulsory rounds.

Round 1: Debugging

  • Duration: 45 minutes
  • Questions: 2 Easy, 1 Medium, 1 Hard
  • Participants will be given erroneous code and must identify and fix the errors.

Round 2: Coding

  • Duration: 60 minutes
  • Questions: 2 Easy, 1 Medium, 1 Hard
  • Participants must write their own code to solve the given problems.

Sample Questions

  • Sample questions will be shared with participants two days before the event.
  • Event questions may be based on the samples, with slight modifications. They will not be completely different from the provided samples.

Programming Languages: Participants may use Java, C/C++, Go, or Python.

Test Cases

Each question will have five test cases:

  • 1 sample test case
  • 2 visible test cases
  • 2 hidden test cases

Evaluation Criteria

Participants will be evaluated based on:

  • Score obtained for each question.
  • Number of questions attempted.
  • Time taken to solve each question.

The best submission for each question will be considered for evaluation.

Rules and Restrictions

  • Both rounds are compulsory.
  • Each round has its own global timer.
  • The use of AI tools, internet access, and external assistance is strictly prohibited.

Give it your best, challenge yourself, and aim for the top. Good luck to everyone participating!
